text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000018 bills 99215 well above expectation in every complexity band, but the limited records sample largely supports the billed levels, so the pattern is unresolved.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The excess 99215 share holds in every complexity band, not just among sicker patients, which argues against panel acuity as the full explanation. The low-complexity samples include visits with only a single simple diagnosis, such as C0008337 (back pain, no chronic conditions) and C0008883 and C0008934 (Z09 follow-up only). Against that, the documented 99215s were mostly supported (e.g., C0008334, C0008560 with high MDM), at a mismatch rate below comparison providers, and only a few moderate-or-higher data-reviewed notes lacked a lab or test line. That is weak evidence of cloned or inflated notes, not proof. However, 15 documented 99215 claims is a thin base, and supportive notes cannot rule out documentation written to match the billed level. A reviewer should first request charts for the low-complexity 99215 claims listed in the packet and check whether high MDM is clinically plausible for diagnoses like I10, M54.50 or Z09 alone. The reviewer should also check whether the supported 99215 records came mainly from multi-morbid patients."}
